svg.aria-label: GROW SCHOOL SUPPORT THROUGH LOCAL CONNECTIONS
svg.text: GROW SCHOOL SUPPORT THROUGH LOCAL CONNECTIONS
Give every school a repeatable way to connect families, businesses,
and community support—without creating a new flyer for every campus.
Built for principals, teams, and district leaders
The core message stays consistent across Olathe Public Schools.
Each authorized admin adds the QR code for the correct school or
campaign, so families always land in the right experience.
That means less collateral to maintain, clearer outreach, and a
recognizable community-giveback program that can scale.
Scan to connect this flyer to the right campaign.
